clause: Curiosity-register row 3 r03#1 exception path (corpus/steal/MASTER_READ_ESTATE.md, executed 2026-10-05): the operator max-concurrency standing law of 2026-09-26 measured a wider envelope (5 concurrent gated workflows at max_concurrency 10 each, watch/inbox/ENVELOPE_50W_HIT_20260926.md), so G8 allows a declared width above 3 only when the script documents a measured envelope receipt; this card pins that exception so it can neither widen silently nor be dropped.
citation_provenance: Fixture-minted FAIL row, same run as G8_width_shape.card.json: validate_card requires every card to cite a registry FAIL row showing its gate failing, and this row is the only G8 failure on record. The exception side of G8 (receipt stamp present, receipt file exists under watch/inbox, gate passes) is exercised by this card's own fixture, which passed the live gate and the seat-law payload check when it was written on 2026-10-05.
scenario_description: Script declares max_concurrency: 10 and documents a measured envelope receipt with an envelope-receipt: stamp naming watch/inbox/gala_20260925/AFTERPARTY_CLOSE_20260926.md, which exists on disk (B2-476 proven-width table): G8 passes and the whole gate is green (exit 0). A stamp naming a missing file or a path outside watch/inbox must NOT pass; that negative is pinned by G8_width_shape.card.json.
regression_criterion: tools/workflow_gate.py check --scenarios configs/workflow_gate_scenarios exits 0 with this card green. The card goes red if (a) the receipt exception stops working (a documented measured envelope no longer excuses a width above 3, or the stamp regex no longer matches the envelope-receipt: family), (b) the exception widens (the fixture passes without a valid existing watch/inbox receipt, detectable by weakening pass_g8_envelope.dwf.ts is impossible because the fixture is immutable, so this fires when the gate accepts stamps pointing at missing files and fail_g8 would then also pass, turning its card red), or (c) the cited row disappears from REGISTRY.jsonl.
rollback_note: Scenario mode is read-only: it writes no registry row and touches no file. Rollback of the exception semantics is a git revert of tools/workflow_gate.py to the pre-2026-10-05 blob, then re-run check --scenarios; if the operator rules the exception out (width cap absolute at 3), file a new dated card revising this fixture's expected_verdict to FAIL/exit 2 first, then change the gate, keeping the decision on the record. The cited fixture FAIL row (line 88) is history and is never erased.
